description: Shows what THIS connection may do for the buyer and, if it can send requests to dealerships, its own daily limit and how much of it is used today (a class or client limit may refuse sooner). It needs no extra permission and shows nothing about dealerships or prices. It also names the Ridekick account this assistant is connected to. A count of null means it could not be read. On a practice account, new requests go only to test dealerships. It answers questions about the buyer's account and limits. It is not needed before you preview or send a request.
name: access_get
title: See permissions and limits
